title: fynkel.RigidBody
description: A rigid body on the entity. Its colliders are the entity's own `fynkel.Collider` (one per entity in V1). A `Collider` without a `RigidBody` is static geometry.

mass.description: Kilograms (dynamic only, `> 0`); the inertia follows the collider shape scaled to this mass.

gravity_scale.description: Multiplies the world's gravity for this body (0 floats).

ccd.description: Continuous collision detection: fast bodies do not tunnel through thin geometry (costs a little per body).

constraints.description: Frozen axes, Unity's `RigidbodyConstraints` bits (dynamic bodies; see [`constraints`]): 2/4/8 freeze the position along X/Y/Z, 16/32/64 the rotation about X/Y/Z, 0 none.
